title: ASR Provenance Stamp
description: Who or what wrote an object, and when. Every top-level ASR object (registry manifest, topics file, source profile) carries one; probe and fetch records carry the lighter tool block instead because they are born mechanical. The stamp answers accountability questions (was this profile model-written? when was it last touched?), not derivation questions — ASR objects are roots, not derived objects, so there is no derived_from here (contrast UPC).

model.description: Model identifier when method is model; null otherwise.

person.description: Human attribution when method is human; null otherwise.

modified_at.description: Set on every subsequent edit; null when never modified.
